summary: This appeal is directed against the order dated 03.08.2023 cancelling the appellant's cold storage licence for non-payment of the renewal fee. The appellant says no show cause notice was ever served on it. Issue notice to the respondent.
directions: This appeal is directed against the order dated 03.08.2023 cancelling the appellant's cold storage licence for non-payment of the renewal fee.
The cancellation is stayed subject to the appellant depositing the renewal fee of Rs. 2,40,000 within two weeks.
